title: Q-DECISION-COVERAGE-1: give every decision-shaped function a declared metric (DECISIONS-1)
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation decisions --check
**Status:** open

DECISIONS-1 instruments six decision points. `uninstrumented` in doctrine/decisions.json lists the decision-shaped functions (choose, decide, pick, route, rank, launch, prioritize, plan, select) that still have no `DECISION-METRIC:` marker. For each: either register a point with its metric, prediction and measure and add the marker, or, if it is not an autonomous decision, record why. The list is shrink-only; `decisions --check` fails when it grows.

size: M

**Prediction:** uninstrumented_decision_files <= 10 within 168 h

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation decisions --check
